basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Persona series enthusiast based in Manchester, UK. Initially drawn to Reddit for gaming communities but soon expanded my interests to tech and visual novels. I'm a part-time graphic designer and spend my evenings diving into RPGs or playing board games with friends. I'm single and often spend weekends exploring new cities or attending comic conventions. Typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge of RPGs, especially the Persona series, driven by years of playing and engaging with the community. Self-taught in graphic design through online courses and practice. Regularly follow updates from game developers and engage in tech forums to stay informed.
